candidates.verdict: OK until a contract requires it or you touch PHI/enterprise data

decision: Buy PI (errors and omissions) plus cyber cover when the first enterprise or healthcare MSA asks for certificates, or before you handle PHI. PI excludes cyber attacks, so the two are separate policies. Size limits to what contracts demand (often USD 1-2M for US enterprises).
details: BimaKavach asks for an incorporation certificate, so check sole-proprietor eligibility. Premiums unverified.

verify.note: Not re-verified (no search budget). Source is a broker's blog, and the file itself flags that sole proprietors may not qualify. Fine as a 'when needed' pointer.
